title: ID0426450-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000690] Technical Query
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On this charger sunDZh, max power displayed on the screen on
EVSE 1 is 120kw and EVSE 3 180KW. But It is a 300kw charger
(300KW available on each EVSE if there is only 1 customer).
ALso in the Metervalues I can read for EVSE 1 "PowerOffered
(periodic): 120000 W".
Why is there a power limitation on EVSE?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0426450-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000690] Technical Query CRM:02679000304
additional_info.body:
Hi Florent,
Charger is Low Flex.
Power Limit in DC1 : 120 & DC2 : 180 kW. as shown below.
To answer your query:
“What I understood about low flex or high flex has no impact on the EVSE power as long as there is only one customer on the charger.
So max power on each EVSE should be 300kw no matter low flex or high flex?”
Yes, You are right, Irrespective of Low Flex and High Flex, For a single customer Max power from a (300kW) charger is 300 kW.
But
, For this charger, As you can see in the charger DC1 and DC2, Max Power are 120 and 180 kW.
We are seeking for your approval if we can update Max Power to 300kW for both DC1 and DC2.
Looking forward to hear back from you.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
